headline: Nigeria Targets 2027 to Settle N3.3 Trillion Power Sector GenCo Debt
summary: Nigeria's Federal Government plans to clear its outstanding 3.3 trillion naira power generation debt owed to electricity generation companies by 2027, according to Minister of Power Joseph Tegbe.
why: Massive legacy debt in Nigeria's power market hampers grid investment and reliable generation, constraining industrial growth.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Resolving N3.3T in outstanding debt obligations restores liquidity to power generation operators.
